Cà phê học bài & xe buýt

bento_hub.outside_windows: Show tomorrow planning and genuinely available late options; do not imply closed businesses are open.
bento_hub.campus_note: Five clusters split Bách Khoa and Sư Phạm; multi-campus universities need explicit campus addresses in the mapping. No GPS permission required.
requirements: Place time-aware Bento and campus controls in the first viewport at 390px and desktop; maintain readable touch targets and keyboard access.
Use explicit local campus/location mappings with documented proximity criteria. A city-wide chain record does not automatically mean near every campus.

Only mark power outlets, study suitability, opening hours, meals <=35K or DanaBus 6K where supported. Capture route/fare eligibility for bus claims. Missing local supply gets an honest empty state plus nearby/city-wide options.
Update time window on boundary and tab resume; test with an injected clock including 07:00, 11:00, 14:00, 18:00, 23:00 and midnight.
bento_hub.filter_performance: Target <20ms from handler start to DOM update for loaded data. Record median, p95 and maximum over at least 30 interactions per viewport with hardware/browser context; also measure next-frame visual feedback separately. No unmeasured latency claim.

voucher_vault.scope: F&B and cinema offers from Batch 18 and Batch 19 plus supported additions, exposed prominently on HOME with access to full Vault.

cta_types.real_code: Sao chép mã — exact supported code; announce success only after clipboard resolves and provide fallback on denial.
cta_types.counter_combo: Xem điều kiện áp dụng ↗ — show Đến quầy nhận ngay only when terms permit counter redemption; preserve delivery/member/channel restrictions.
cta_types.app_wallet: Mở App nhận deal ↗ — official deep-link or working official web fallback.

voucher_vault.counting: Deduplicate by stable offer ID. Lack of a code never hides a valid counter deal. Discovery, expired deals and ordinary observed-price cards do not count toward the minimum 30 hot offers. Derive counts from data and disclose shortfall.
voucher_vault.baseline_note: Previous 42 rendered Vault cards included two discovery records; 42 is not a count of verified hot offers. Reassess current eligibility rather than inheriting the headline.

ktx_radar.label: Giá khảo sát thực tế — Kiểm tra tồn kho tại sàn
requirements: Expand the existing 15 records into at least 30 distinct product listings across the requested categories. Broad campaigns do not count as individual products.
Store product ID/model, merchant, exact product URL, observed price, currency, capture time, source and availability caveats. Do not invent prices, stock or seller official status.
Use Shopee/Tiki official shops or verified retailer product pages; label direct retailer websites accurately. Validate final destinations, not HTTP 200 alone.

Use authorized affiliate links and publisher identifiers when supplied or already configured. Disclose commission links. If none exists, ship direct links and mark monetization pending account configuration; do not claim commission revenue or create accounts/agreements.

zalo_pass.button: 🍿 Xuất Vé Kèo Rủ Bạn (Zalo Pass) ↗
zalo_pass.implementation: Provide a local Canvas PNG boarding pass with amount/person and group count plus a copyable message including https://jayt-production-v3420.vercel.app. Feature-detect native sharing and fall back to PNG download/message copy.
zalo_pass.privacy: Generate locally; omit payer identity and arbitrary free text from exported defaults. Do not request contacts or GPS. Sharing is initiated by the user; never auto-send messages.
zalo_pass.arithmetic: Integer VND only; preserve total with explicit remainder allocation. Test the actual UI calculator and exported values for divisible/non-divisible totals, invalid inputs and group sizes 2..8.

evidence.methods: Official detail HTML/API or rendered screenshot plus reviewed terms and raw artifact hashes; SPA is acceptable and no static-selector allowlist is required.
evidence.rules: Retain prior archives. Separate confirmed claims from discovery. Show restrictions beside CTAs; a branch address alone is not proof of offer participation.

acceptance: Serve candidate on :4176. Record served file hashes and runner hash in the receipt; preserve J361/J362 production evidence.
Test 1440/768/390px: first viewport Bento, each campus/time filter, exact visible IDs, CTA destinations, keyboard interaction, no console/runtime errors or overflow.
Derive supply counts from unique eligible records and cross-check HOME, Vault, Radar and feed. Report held/discovery separately.
Exercise actual copy/share/download paths, clipboard denial and privacy network/storage checks; test real exported image/message values.
Provide measured filter latency and functional seven-day timeline results; do not infer these from card counts.
Gemini experiences the staging product and records retention feedback. Chairman approval is required for subsequent v3.431.0 production release.
